findings.message: `model: "gpt-4"`: `gpt-4` is not a Claude model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full `claude-*` model ID
findings.fix: Use a native Claude model, or one from [policy.models.claude].models in agenvil.toml.

findings.message: `effort: "ultra"`: `ultra` is not a Claude effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, max)
findings.fix: Use a native Claude effort, or one from [policy.models.claude].efforts in agenvil.toml.
Write `tools` as a list of the tool names the agent needs, or remove it to inherit all tools.

findings.message: claude-opus-4-6/xhigh is allowed but the target does not support it (`claude-opus-4-6` does not support effort `xhigh` (it supports low, medium, high, max); Claude Code would silently run a lower level) and no mapping is configured; add a [[targets.<name>.map]] entry or change the source
findings.fix: Choose a supported pair, add a [[targets.claude.map]] entry, or add the pair to [policy.models.claude].pairs.
